name: token-efficient-scripts
description: Write throwaway bash/python for one-off file & data tasks so they cost minimal tokens and run fast. Also covers recovering from a failed command without paying for a man page. Ships a PreToolUse hook that actually blocks an unfiltered `man` and hands back the cheaper ladder. Bundles the skill, /bench and /bench-recovery commands that re-run the benchmarks and log new findings, and a stop hook.
